# IPTV Trends

> IPTV Trends (trendsiptv.com) is a premium IPTV subscription service that streams 21,000+ live TV channels from 50+ countries and 65,000+ movies and series over the internet, in quality up to 4K UHD. It works on Smart TV, Amazon Firestick, Android, iPhone and iPad, Apple TV, MAG boxes, PC and Mac through apps such as IPTV Smarters Pro and TiviMate. IPTV Trends operates only at trendsiptv.com and is not affiliated with other websites that use a similar name.

## Key facts

- Plans: 1 month $19.99, 3 months $39.99, 6 months $55.99, 12 months $79.99, 24 months $129.99 (about $5.42 per month)
- Free trial: 24 hours, requested on WhatsApp
- Refunds: 7-day money-back guarantee
- Activation: instant, login details sent on WhatsApp after payment
- Support: 24/7 on WhatsApp (+212 707-711512) in English, French, Arabic and Spanish
- Payment: Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, Bitcoin, USDT, bank transfer
